claude.sample_unit: pathologists (reader study); 4,679 biopsies in retrospective multi-hospital simulation
models_evaluated: vision foundation model pre-trained on 70,618 whole slide images, fine-tuned on 10,462 gastric biopsies (29-category classifier)

links.outcome: Pathologist sensitivity with versus without concurrent AI assistance
links.effect: Concurrent AI assistance significantly improved sensitivity for malignancy (92.2% to 94.8%, P = .034) and metaplasia (94.2% to 97.4%, P = .013) in six-pathologist reader study.
links.quote: In a prospective reader study with six pathologists, concurrent AI assistance significantly improves sensitivity for malignancy (92.2% to 94.8%, P = .034) and metaplasia (94.2% to 97.4%, P = .013).

links.outcome: Model performance across four independent hospital cohorts in retrospective simulation
links.effect: Post-read system across four independent hospital cohorts (n = 4,679) identified 17 malignancies missed or miscoded in routine diagnostic records.
links.quote: In retrospective simulation across four independent hospital cohorts ( n = 4,679), the post-read system identifies 17 malignancies that were missed or miscoded in routine diagnostic records.

unlisted_practices: post-read AI alert system as retrospective quality assurance for missed diagnoses
foundation model fine-tuning on small datasets (400 slides) for data efficiency
